notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.2 - Battle Background Overhaul
notes.content:
This patch simply overhauls the battle background system to give more area specific, custom, backgrounds. They are higher resolution and far more colourful and in theme with the rest of the game. I hope you enjoy.

If you want to take a look you can view them on my blog @ warpedtales(dot)weebly(dot)com/     (you ned to replace the (dot) with a full stop!)

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.1.1
notes.content:
This patch adds some visual improvements and addresses late game balancing issues.

  * Added particle effects to the menu system.
  * Improved some of the game's base textures.
  * Enemies now level to the average party member rather than the highest.
  * Some of the late game spells have been strengthened.
  * Many enemies have been tweaked to make them more enjoyable to fight.
  * The 'Warped Tales' Splash screen has been removed as it was stopping some players starting the game.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.1.0 - Difficulty settings and more!
notes.content:
This patch addresses some of the feedback about the game's difficulty, early characters, and weapons/armours in Driftburgh. The bellow information contains story spoilers.

  * Added a difficulty setting to the options menu. It can be changed at any time. What does it do? Changes the way enemy level scaling works. On easier difficulties you are more likely to run into creatures 5-10 levels below your current one.

  * Added leveled skills to Gretel and Ratter. It was always our intention for Sophia to outstrip her companions which is why she changes them relatively often, but I understand that by the end of Driftburgh people were frustrated by the lack of progression with Gretel and Ratter. To this end I have added new affinities to these characters that are learned at certain levels.

  * Added new weapons and armour and weapon loot crates to Driftburgh and the surroundings.

  * Fixed a memory leak issue regarding enemy level progression.

  * Fixed other various bugs and typos.

notes.title: Update and Coming Soon
notes.content:

I't's just myself working on this now. With the Proof-reading the first DLC, helping get a Greenlight Video ready for Sublime Games' 'Rune Monsters' - which Warped Tales has helped create and is publishing, bug-fixing, and making sure my 1yo daughter doesn't eat my keyboard I'm a little overwhelmed!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.0.4 - Graphics Options
notes.content: This patch simply adds two options to the 'Options Menu'. One to disable weather effects, and one to disable fog effects. This should help considerably on laptops experiencing lag and on the few desktops with stutter issues.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Another small bug squishing patch containing...

•	Fixed some passage issues in the lava caves.
•	Ratter’s ‘helping people’ conversation has been correctly marked to only happen once.
•	‘Power Gem’ text now wordwraps correctly.
•	 Fixed passage overlap near Rocky Ledge.
•	Sludgelord clay now collects correctly for ‘Pinocchio’ quest.
•	Driftburgh escape route should no longer show up early.
•	Fixed a bug where Matt can be repeatedly fought!
•	Nepenthe and unknown slime description fixed.
•	Small grammatical errors fixed.
•	Text codes sometimes showing up, fixed.
•	Fixed a bug where you could hand in Tattered Flag missions to both Jarred and Cassandra.
•	Fixed an infinite process event causing memory issues.

Thanks again to Ledeir, Thomnie2099, and Ramon for taking the time to report theses issues, and for surpassing even our eagle-eyed beta testers.
